name: CheckpointCore
summary: Checkpoint native iOS geofencing/location engine (Capacitor-free core).
description: The Checkpoint location / geofence / ingest engine for iOS. The SDK is a sensor; all detection logic runs server-side. This pod is the framework-agnostic core consumed by the Capacitor, React Native, Flutter, Cordova, NativeScript, and KMP wrappers, and usable directly from native Swift apps.
